paragraphs: Mar bar Rav Idai: [Chullin 63a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.63a.11); Yevamot 106a has Mar bar Idi.[^1]

notes.text: The objection attributed to Mar bar Idi occurs at [Yevamot 106b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.106b.10) in Davidson. Hyman cites 106a and records the fuller bar Rav Idai form for Chullin.
